_about: Recorded-style sounds generated once with the ElevenLabs Sound Effects API (python3 sound/samples_fetch.py) and committed. kind: sfx (one-shot, mono unless stereo: true) or bed (an ambience loop, stereo). level: the default LU relative to the voice (like SFX_REL in build.py).

el_lock_click.p: A single old interior bedroom door lock bolt turning slowly and clicking open, quiet house at night, close and crisp, slight hallway reverb

el_handle_strain.p: Someone on the other side of a door gently pressing down a metal door handle, the handle creaks and strains against a hand holding it shut, close, quiet room

el_feet_landing.p: Slow soft bare footsteps on a carpeted upstairs landing at night, approaching and stopping right outside a door, floorboard creak under carpet

el_stairs_down.p: Slow bare footsteps going down creaky old wooden stairs at night, heard from upstairs through a door, quiet house

el_backdoor.p: A back door downstairs unlocking and swinging open, banging against the wall, wind and rain rushing in, heard from upstairs

el_wade_slow.p: A person wading slowly through waist deep river water at night, water swirling around legs, steady steps, rain on the water surface

el_run_into_water.p: Running barefoot across wet grass and splashing hard into a river, big splashes, urgent, night

el_pulled_under.p: A child being suddenly pulled into a fast river, a sharp heavy splash and rushing water, then a hand grabbing him and lifting out, water pouring off

el_gasp_out.p: A young child gasping and coughing after being pulled out of cold water, close

el_sit_up.p: Bed sheets and duvet rustling as a small child suddenly sits bolt upright in bed, quiet bedroom at night

el_clock_tick.p: A bedside alarm clock ticking loudly in a silent bedroom at night, three ticks, close

el_clock_flip.p: A digital bedside clock changing number with a single soft electronic click, silent room

el_phone_video.p: Video playing through a small phone speaker: rain and rushing flood water, tinny and compressed, quiet kitchen

el_phone_grass.p: Picking up a wet phone from wet grass, a damp rustle and a small tap on the screen

el_mug_down.p: A ceramic mug of tea placed down on a wooden fence post, a soft knock, morning outdoors

el_heartbeat.p: Slow heavy human heartbeat, muffled and deep, horror tension, felt in the chest, steady

el_heartbeat_fast.p: Fast pounding human heartbeat, muffled and deep, panic, horror film

el_breath_hold.p: A scared teenage girl trying to breathe silently in the dark, shaky held breath, trembling exhale, very close

el_whisper_air.p: Eerie faint breathy air through a gap under a door at night, a cold draught, ghostly but subtle

el_riser_short.p: Horror movie tension riser, dissonant strings and reversed cymbal rising for three seconds into a cut, cinematic

el_riser_long.p: Slow horror tension riser building for eight seconds, low strings, dark synth swell and heartbeat pulse rising, cinematic

el_hit_boom.p: Deep cinematic horror impact boom with long dark reverb tail, trailer hit

el_hit_sub.p: Cinematic sub bass drop, deep low frequency boom falling away, horror trailer

el_sting_strings.p: Sudden horror string stinger, screeching dissonant violins, jump scare, short

el_whoosh_dark.p: Dark cinematic whoosh transition, low and airy, horror

el_typewriter.p: Old typewriter typing a short phrase, crisp key strikes, quiet room, no bell

el_thunder.p: Distant thunder rolling slowly across the sky at night, deep rumble, rain

el_child_steps_wet.p: Small bare child footsteps walking slowly on wet grass and mud at night, squelching

el_door_creak.p: A wooden bedroom door creaking slowly open in a silent house at night

el_water_rush.p: A sudden strong river current surging and rushing, water pulling hard, menacing, night

el_underwater.p: Muffled underwater sound, bubbles and a dull current, as if heard with your head under the water

el_drip_quiet.p: Single water drips falling from a gutter onto a wet patio in a quiet dawn garden

el_time_stop.p: Sci-fi time freeze effect: a deep sub-bass whoomp that sucks all sound away, a reversed shimmer, then dead silence with a faint high ring

el_time_resume.p: Sci-fi time resuming: a sharp rush of air and sound slamming back in, a deep whoosh, rain and city noise returning all at once

el_gunshot.p: A single pistol gunshot in a rainy city street at night, sharp crack with an echo off tall buildings

el_bullet_wall.p: A bullet hitting a concrete wall, a sharp crack and chips of concrete falling

el_implant.p: A cybernetic implant being installed: an electric whine powering up, a sharp click and crackling sparks, then a soft digital beep

el_counter_tick.p: A single soft digital counter tick, a low electronic blip, futuristic interface

el_alarm.p: A high-tech security alarm blaring in a vault, pulsing electronic siren, urgent

el_door_blast.p: Heavy metal security doors blasting open, a pneumatic hiss and a slam, armoured boots rushing in

el_gun_cock.p: A futuristic pistol being cocked and aimed, a sharp mechanical click and a rising electronic charge whine

el_van_door.p: A van sliding door slammed shut in the rain, a heavy metallic thud

el_hacking.p: Fast futuristic hacking sounds: rapid soft keyboard taps and digital interface beeps and chirps

el_heart_slow.p: A single human heartbeat slowing down in silence, deep and muffled, each beat further apart

el_neon_buzz.p: A flickering neon sign buzzing and crackling in the rain, close

el_siren_far.p: Distant police and ambulance sirens echoing through a rainy futuristic city at night

el_door_shut.p: A front door of a small apartment closing gently, a soft latch click, quiet hallway

el_slide_down.p: A person's back sliding slowly down a wooden door and sitting on the floor: fabric rubbing on wood, a soft thump

el_memory_drain.p: A memory being pulled out of someone's mind: a soft glassy hum rising, shimmering crystal tones sucked away into a bottle, ending in a gentle glass chime

el_vial_chime.p: A small glass vial set down on a steel counter: a clear delicate glass chime with a soft ring

el_humming.p: A teenage girl softly humming a simple gentle made-up lullaby melody to herself, close and intimate, no words

el_cough.p: A sick teenage girl coughing weakly twice in a quiet bedroom

el_memory_flood.p: Memories flooding back: a warm swelling shimmer of chimes and soft light, rising and blooming, magical and emotional

elb_river_rain.p: Dark river at night with steady heavy rain falling on the water, strong current flowing, distant wind, immersive, no thunder

elb_in_river.p: Standing waist deep in a fast river at night, water rushing and swirling close around you, heavy rain hitting the water surface all around

elb_rain_window.p: Heavy rain on a bedroom window at night heard from inside, muffled, gentle wind, quiet house, cozy but tense

elb_house_night.p: A silent house at three in the morning, faint low fridge hum downstairs, very quiet room tone, the house settling, subtle

elb_dawn_garden.p: An English back garden at dawn just after rain, water dripping from leaves and gutters, a few distant birds, a river flowing gently in the distance, still and grey

elb_kitchen_day.p: A quiet family kitchen on a grey morning, faint fridge hum, a clock ticking softly, light rain outside the window, subdued

elb_neon_city.p: A dense futuristic cyberpunk city at night in heavy rain: rain on metal and puddles, a low electric hum of neon signs, distant hover traffic, crowd murmur, occasional far sirens

elb_roof_night.p: A high rooftop at night above a huge futuristic city: wind, distant city hum far below, soft rain, a faint drone flying past

elb_flat_rain.p: A tiny apartment in a futuristic city at night: rain on the window, a fridge hum, muffled neon buzz and traffic outside

elb_vault.p: A high-tech corporate vault interior: a cold low electrical hum, servers whirring softly, very quiet and sterile

elb_classroom.p: A quiet high school classroom during a lesson: pens scratching, a chair creaking, a pupil coughing, a teacher talking far away, rain outside the window

elb_market.p: A busy indoor futuristic market at night: a murmuring crowd, soft electronic beeps, glass clinking, a low neon hum, rain outside
